name: Primeval
description:
Primeval adds a GPU Quick Settings tile to switch NVIDIA PRIME profiles.

Maps prime-select modes to short labels:
* Integrated (intel)
* Dedicated (nvidia)
* Optimus (on-demand)

When the menu is expanded, shows live GPU stats from `nvtop -s` (device name, memory used/total when available, GPU Utilization, and VRAM Utilization). Stats are queried only while the menu is open.

Requires nvidia-prime (`prime-select`), pkexec, and nvtop. Switching profiles runs `pkexec prime-select <profile>` (system prime-select binary) and usually needs a logout or reboot to apply.
